def read_authored_png(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();pos=8;chunks=[];w=h=0
 while pos<len(data):
  n=struct.unpack_from('>I',data,pos)[0];typ=data[pos+4:pos+8];chunk=data[pos+8:pos+8+n];pos+=12+n
  if typ==b'IHDR':w,h=struct.unpack_from('>II',chunk)
  if typ==b'IDAT':chunks.append(chunk)
 raw=np.frombuffer(zlib.decompress(b''.join(chunks)),np.uint8).reshape(h,w*4+1)
 assert not raw[:,0].any()
 return raw[:,1:].reshape(h,w,4)[::-1].astype(np.float32)/255
def write_png(name,arr):
 a=np.round(np.clip(arr,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1];h,w=a.shape[:2]
 def chunk(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
 b=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))
 b+=chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+r.tobytes() for r in a),6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
 path=tex/(name+'.png');path.write_bytes(b)
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.name=name;im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB';im.pack();return im
